notes: action: download = CalcSuite downloads it on a click and sends 'send' (zip member patterns, lower case, fnmatch; Nspire: the folder it goes to); page = open info_url in the browser; ti_page = TI's page (its licence), never downloaded by CalcSuite.
verified: false means the entry came from a directory listing: its file names were not checked.

items.name: Cesium 3.8.0
items.description: Program launcher/shell: runs any program (BASIC or ASM, archived or not) from a menu, hides, locks and renames programs.
items.author: MateoConLechuga
items.license: not stated on ticalc page or release page

items.name: CE C Libraries (clibs) v15.0
items.description: Shared runtime libraries (graphics, keypad, fonts, file I/O) that most C/ASM programs need. Install once.
items.author: CE-Programming (mateoconlechuga et al.)
items.license: not shown on release page (check repo LICENSE)
items.os_notes: Libraries themselves work on any CE OS. The programs that use them need ASM (5.4.0 ok; 5.5+ needs arTIfiCE).
items.special_handling: Offer to install automatically when a picked item lists clibs as a dependency. Resolve 'latest' through the GitHub API instead of pinning v15.0.

items.name: KhiCAS (χCAS) for TI-84 Plus CE
items.description: A full computer algebra system (from Giac/Xcas): symbolic solve, derivatives, integrals, matrices, plus a Python-like language, inside the CE.
items.author: Bernard Parisse (Giac by B. Parisse and R. De Graeve)
items.license: GPL2 (allocator_standard.c is GPL3). The INST installer is closed source but free to run and redistribute for non-commercial use.
items.source_site: Bernard Parisse, Univ. Grenoble Alpes (Institut Fourier)
items.size: about 3 MB of archive once installed
items.os_notes: Below OS 5.5 (so 5.4.0) you run INST straight from the prgm menu. 5.5+ needs the artifice step first. The author warns it would not run on the latest OS and says never to upgrade the OS.
items.special_handling: Needs about 2948-3014K ARC FREE: back up and purge the archive (including language packs) first. Multi-file install, then run INST on the calculator and delete the leftover install AppVars. Show these steps in a wizard. Never offer an OS update to this user.
